The Fire God and second son of Heavenly Emperor—Xufeng—was ambushed and trespassed to the Reflection Space in the Flower Realm. Suffering from injuries, he was rescued and treated by the clumsy Jinmi. Jinmi was then brought back to the Heavens by Xufeng, without realizing Xufeng’s true identity. Pourtant, ce dernier est déterminé à l’en empêcher. Un an plus tôt, Yang avait tiré Lu Fei d'une situation périlleuse liée à une guerre de territoire entre gangs. Depuis, en signe de reconnaissance, Lu Fei vit chez lui et s'occupe de toutes les tâches ménagères. Mais lorsqu’il exprime le désir de retrouver son ancienne vie dangereuse, les choses prennent une tournure inattendue. One midnight on his way back to the dorms, Ding Chenzui, a second-year college student who has absolutely no interest in drinking, runs into Huang Kuan and Liu Lingzi, who have crossed over from another timeline. From that moment on, Ding Chenzui is drawn into a battle across time and space against the "Xumi Realm" for the recipe of the Divine Wine.

Luo'Hua was found under a Mu Dan Blossom Tree as a baby, and taken in by a man where she joined his family. The man's wife regards her as her husband's child out of wedlock (and a curse that made their beautiful flower garden die), so Luo-Hua lives her life suffering because of these assumptions, and her only friend is her stepbrother, Yi Qing. As a teenager, Luo'Hua is taken in as a servant in the Gui household to repay her family's debt to the Gui family, and finds herself among much conflict as she's assigned to deliver the young master's clothes and meals under the Gui Madam's schemes.
A tender tale of love and loss, where someone dear reappears in a different form of life.

Jian Renxin，a man who was born as a cannon fodde, accidentally obtained martial arts cheats. Although he had the companionship of beautiful junior sisters and handsome senior priests, he still got killed by Iron rod in the presence of all. He wanted to live in a different way after the reincarnation . How could he get rid of the bad luck and overturn the whole situation？“I am the master of my own destiny!”

The ancient country of Jiang can only be visited in Longkui's dreams. The past memories of her unwavering father, devoted mother, and brother she grew up with, were her only source of sweetness for a long time. At the same time there was lingering pain. These memories warmed her but also disturbed her. Because of this sweetness, she struggled in silence and darkness, unable to free herself. A thousand years later, she finally started, cautiously taking her first step...

In a certain era, in a certain corner of the vast universe, humans have already entered the universe and established a huge/great empire. In this time period, the concept of "states" does not exist. Instead, private capitals and giant enterprises make up the government, and control every aspect of society. Besides from private property, nothing else is sacred. Dong Zhong Min, who's hometown near the border got destroyed and Chu Ping, who wants to find someplace she can call home after being ruined by her family, journey together far and wide.

Liang Qiu, a boyish-looking girl who just moved to the city, finds herself in a situation in which she has to help her classmate Lei Yi Xin by taking care of his meals while his mother is out of the country. Lei Yi Xin has the reputation of being a very hasty and cold person. Liang Qiu's friend, LuLu, warned her about that, and told her to be careful! How will their relationship work?  
  
From Tokyopop: Xiao Chiu dreams of becoming a great Chinese chef, always has the urge to cook food when she's in the kitchen, and cuts vegetables whenever she has a knife in her hands. Her passion for cooking was rewarded when she found a well-paying job - to be Lei's personal chef for a month. But Lei is arrogant, smokes, has a bad temper… and is very picky about food. He has a sensitive stomach and will throw up if something he ate does not agree with him. He also will not eat anything that doesn't suit his taste. What a hard-to-satisfy guy Lei just happens to be her classmate, too Poor Xiao Chiu Even worse, after one month, having spent day and night together, they develop tangled feelings towards each other Xiao Chiu feels confused. In seeing the one-month deadline approaching, she decides to run away. But, if she does not cook for him, Lei may get sick again… Xiao Chiu, what are you going to do?

In the apocalyptic world full of monsters, "Hong Que", a young girl engineered as a human weapon by mankind, wished for freedom to a God. But nothing comes without a cost... 

What awaits this human weapon is an even heavier and agonizing price to pay.
This is a collection of some cute animal stories.

The Wicked Woman Inspector is trapped in this tiny prison island with hundreds of desperate prisoners. Throughout the day she had been accompanied by violence and madness, and she had been training her heart to be made of iron and steel, yet she longed for someone to cast a soft light upon her on this heartless prison island. However, when that long-awaited warmth comes from an old enemy, is she waiting for redemption or endless pain?

Humans are the most dangerous species on earth and Peace Residence isn’t peaceful, after all… A small neighborhood where the innocents and the non-innocents live, a series of strange incidents that may or may not relate to one another… Behind each story there is a secret—the danger that lurks around the neighborhood. While the true peace lies in his hands—the hands of an ordinary people’s police.

Experience horrifying tales, with each story based deep on the ideas of folklore. Each new tale is not only guaranteed to frighten, but it also exposes the darker sides of humanity. A series of horror stories filled with unexpected outcomes that chill to the bone

The first time the emperor met his daughter, he saw this chubby little one fishing a koi carp from the pond, and said hello in that cute baby voice. The second time they met, the princess ran into the imperial garden by accident and interrupted his meeting with the officials. She handed the sour apricot to the emperor from her pocket. Since then, the indifferent emperor who never liked children became a doting father?!

Much evidence showed that it was only a suicide but the appearance of a pair of glasses put Song Tianqi in doubt. With the help of two students Li Musha and He Mi’na, he decided to carry out a thorough investigation.

description.fr:
Une jeune femme qui fait carrière en aidant les librairies de mangas à vendre leurs marchandises traîne un lourd passé. Ce passé la hante jusqu’au jour où elle croise la route d’un inconnu venu lui louer une chambre. C’est autour d’un plateau de go que ces deux anciens prodiges se lieront d’une amitié inhabituelle qui leur permettra de réparer les traumatismes psychologiques que la pratique intense de ce jeu leur a occasionnés. 
« Au go, j'ai l'impression de tâtonner dans le silence des ténèbres. » 

S'inspirant de la carrière professionnelle de véritables joueurs de go, la mangaka Xiaodao dépeint les problématiques actuelles touchant le monde du go et révèle, pierre après pierre, une infinité de combinaisons en noir et blanc.

Bo Zeluo is Yisha's Kingdom most powerful Prince, but while on a mission he suffers a serious injury that turns him into a useless Butterfly.
In order to get back everything he lost, he searches everywhere for a Guide able to heal him. A-Level Guide, He Lanyu, in order to use him to get vengeance, purposely appears next to him as prey during one of the Prince's hunting sessions.
The two don't trust each other, but the attraction between them is undeniable.
Their suspicion brings hunter and prey to test each other constantly, pushing one another to their very limit...

But because he can't understand the language of Qi Dan, the people of Qi Dan can't get along with Men Ji and vice versa. In order for Ke Yi to help Men Ji fit into the Qi Dan lifestyle, she vows to teach him what she is best at, the Qi Dan dance.

Time holds little importance as fighters from many eras and periods of history share the same timeline. From the hit video game series SNK vs. Capcom comes an exciting martial arts event. Capcom's most popular fighting game characters face off against SNK's legendary masters. All your favorite characters are here: Vega, Mai Shiranui, Dimitri - the Vampire, Chun Li, Guile, Akuma, the mysterious Mr. Karate, and others have all gathered for reasons yet to be revealed. Witness explosive battles between Ryu and Kyo Kusanagi, Terry Bogard vs. M. Bison, Iori vs. Balrog and many more seemingly unlikely match-ups. Some fight for glory, some for survival, while others keep secret a more sinister purpose.
